claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament is being held at the Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia.
The 2026 Masters Tournament runs from April 6–12, 2026.
The final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament takes place on Sunday, April 12, 2026.
The Masters Tournament is the only major championship played at the same venue every year.
Coverage for the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on CBS, Paramount+, and Masters.com.
Augusta National Golf Club is located in Augusta, Georgia.
Augusta National Golf Club is located near the South Carolina border.
Augusta National Golf Club is approximately 75–95 miles from Columbia.
Augusta National Golf Club is approximately 75–95 miles from Athens.
